title: linaria supina subsp. haenseleri
intro: Linaria supina subsp. haenseleri, commonly known as Haensel's Toadflax, is a plant species belonging to the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Haensel's Toadflax include stimulating the nervous system, improving circulation, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic compounds, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
